ignore.label: Hide from List
ignore.description: Temporarily hide this file from the organizer. You can restore it anytime.

dbOnly.label: Remove from SWAYA
dbOnly.descriptionMedia: Removes the item from SWAYA only. Your actual files on disk remain untouched.
dbOnly.descriptionExtra: Removes this extra from SWAYA only. The file on disk remains untouched.

trash.label: Move to Trash
trash.descriptionMedia: Sends the media file to your system trash and removes it from SWAYA. Linked extras will also be deleted.
trash.descriptionExtra: Sends this extra file to your system trash and removes it from SWAYA.

bulkDelete.title: Remove selected files
bulkDelete.description: Choose an action to apply to all {count} selected items.

dbOnly.descriptionMedia: Removes the selected media from SWAYA only. Your files on disk remain untouched.
dbOnly.descriptionExtra: Removes the selected extras from SWAYA only. Your files on disk remain untouched.
dbOnly.descriptionMixed: Removes selected media and extras from SWAYA only. Your files on disk remain untouched.

trash.descriptionMedia: Sends the selected media files to your system trash and removes them from SWAYA.
trash.descriptionExtra: Sends the selected extra files to your system trash and removes them from SWAYA.
trash.descriptionMixed: Sends the selected media and extra files to your system trash and removes them from SWAYA.
